segments.text:
V. 4.
Take heed that no man deceive you—The Caution is more particularly deſigned for the ſucceeding Chriſtians, whom the Apoſtles then repreſented. The firſt Sign of my Coming is, the Riſe of falſe Prophets. But it is highly probable many of theſe Things refer to more important Events, which are yet to come.
